claims.claim: The helper for manifest-state Git status/diff queries configures execFileSync timeout=15000 and converts a thrown execution error to null.
claims.exceptions: Only these helper calls, not every Git command; no claim that all child processes are guaranteed to terminate at precisely 15 seconds.
claims.enforcement_effect: Potential time-triggered fallback into unavailable-Git handling; downstream effects depend on caller and saved state.

baseline_comparisons.reason: Range is implementation-classified. Explicit baseline actions reviewed do not specify this numeric execution budget.
Helper implementation and failure swallowing are recognized, not this independent configured deadline.
State persistence or root-selection behavior is represented; neither action expresses the configured timeout trigger.

claims.comparison_reason: A finite helper budget is source-grounded, separate from the host advisory-hook budget and broad product external-I/O guidance. Normative significance versus implementation safeguard remains unresolved.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: A slow otherwise valid Git query reaches the helper budget and falls into unavailable-Git handling, unlike the same query with a longer configured timeout; no hook was executed.
claims.open_question: Is the specific Git-helper budget an independently effective constraint worth registration beyond already-recorded failure handling?
claims.next_evidence_strategy: Family4 trace caller branches and compare baseline exceptions; isolate pure predicates if needed. Family5 challenge whether numeric implementation settings add an independent constraint.
